The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 1dd659698d3a3fde), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 94. statement: Work in the physical passage and annulus-transfer framework of Definition 8.2 and Lemma 8.12, with the comparisons of Corollary 8.6 available. Let Gi, i ≥ i0, be own-unit rules with positive deterministic normalization coefficients bi. Assume that, for every base i, its actual relative-offset laws under the intrinsic transport and quantum-unit identities (8.2)–(8.4) are (bi+ℓ/bi)Gi+ℓ in the base i reference units. In particular these are the conditional kernels on the physical annuli to which the annulus-transfer estimates apply. Suppose every Gi satisfies, with probability above the annulus transfer threshold, fixed shell tests with constants 0 < m < M < ∞: lower crossing bounds m for the passage rule and reference metric, surrounding upper bounds M for both, and an upper crossing bound M for each with endpoints to which the other’s lower bound applies. Then there is T < ∞, depending only on m, M and the fixed geometry, such that T−2 ≤ bi/bj ≤ T2 for all i, j ≥ i0.
